id.help: Unique id; maps, research, factions and jobs name it.

glyph.help: One letter shown when there is no art.

moveType.help: How the unit moves over terrain.

stats.help: Base value per stat of the game.

maxLevel.help: Level cap of this type (0 = never levels; needs progression).

wields.help: Weapon groups the unit can use (carried weapons).

tags.help: Free words that skills and filters test.

resist.help: Flat resistance per damage type (whole numbers within resistRange).

ap.help: Action-point overrides for this type (needs rules.actionPoints).

step.help: Points per square for this type.

softCap.help: Movement points at plain price for this type.

jump.help: Height jump of this type: a number, or { up, down } (needs rules.height).
